name: Spaghetti Bolognese
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add finely chopped onion and minced garlic; sauté until translucent.
Add the minced beef and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon.
Stir in tomato sauce, season with salt and pepper, and simmer for 15‑20 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook spaghetti according to package instructions and drain.
Combine the sauce with the cooked spaghetti and serve hot.

name: Beef Chili
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add diced onion and minced garlic; sauté until softened.
Add the minced beef and brown it thoroughly.
Stir in chili powder, cumin, salt, canned diced tomatoes, and drained kidney beans.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30‑40 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve the chili hot, optionally with rice or crusty bread.

name: Beef Tacos
instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium‑high heat.
Add finely chopped onion and minced garlic; cook until fragrant.
Add the minced beef, season with cumin, salt, and pepper, and cook until fully browned.
Warm taco shells according to package instructions.
Fill each shell with the cooked beef, shredded lettuce, grated cheddar cheese, and a spoonful of salsa.

name: Classic Beef Burgers
instructions: Form the minced beef into evenly sized patties and season with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a grill pan over medium‑high heat.
Cook the patties 4‑5 minutes per side, or until desired doneness.
Toast the burger buns lightly in the pan.
Assemble each burger with lettuce, sliced tomato, onion, a cheese slice, ketchup, and mustard.

name: Beef Meatballs in Tomato Sauce
instructions: In a bowl combine minced beef, breadcrumbs, beaten egg, grated parmesan, minced garlic, salt, and pepper; mix well.
Form the mixture into small meatballs.
Heat olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat; add chopped onion and sauté until translucent.
Add the meatballs and brown on all sides.
Pour in canned tomato sauce, add chopped basil, and simmer for 20‑25 minutes until meatballs are cooked through.
Serve the meatballs over pasta or with crusty bread.
